National Projects Construction Corporation Limited (NPCC), a Government of India enterprise and Mini Ratna Category-I company, has released an official notification for the recruitment of 12 regular vacancies across various officer posts. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official portal.

Overview and Important Dates

  • Issuing Authority: NPCC Limited
  • Notification ID / Reference: Not specified
  • Online Application Opening Date: 1 November 2026
  • Online Application Closing Date: 22 November 2026 (11:59 P.M.)
  • Age and Experience Cut-Off Date: 30 September 2026

Vacancy Details and Eligibility

The recruitment drive features a total of 12 tentative regular vacancies spanning seven distinct officer positions, including roles in HR, Finance, IT, Raj Bhasha, and Law. The largest group among these is Deputy Manager (Finance) with 4 vacancies.

  • General Manager (HR): Oversees administration and human resource functions at the corporate office.
  • Manager (Finance) & Dy. Manager (Fin.): Handles institutional finance, budgetary planning, accounts, taxation, and auditing (knowledge of GST and Ind AS is desirable).
  • Manager (HR): Manages recruitment, training, compensation, industrial relations, and labour law compliance.
  • Manager (IT): Responsible for information and communication systems, networks, and hardware/software upkeep.
  • Manager (Raj Bhasha): Ensures compliance with the Official Languages Act (Ph.D. in Hindi preferred).
  • Dy. Manager (Law): Manages company litigation, legal agreements, and regulatory compliance (Post Graduate degree in Law preferred).

Age Limits and Relaxations

The upper age limit is subject to government norms, with relaxations provided as follows:

  • SC / ST Candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation
  • PwBD & Ex-Servicemen: As per Government of India rules
  • Internal Candidates: Age is no bar

Application Fees and Selection Process

  • Application Fee: Payable exclusively through the online payment gateway. Specific fee amounts are Not specified in the primary details; applicants should verify via the official portal.
  • Selection Stages: The selection procedure will be determined by NPCC based on the volume of responses received, which may include a Personal Interview or other appropriate evaluation methods. Shortlisted candidates may be eligible for rail fare reimbursement (2nd or 3rd AC sleeper depending on the level).

How to Verify and Apply

Candidates are advised to review all terms, conditions, and document requirements carefully before applying:

  • Visit the official website at www.npcc.gov.in to access the notification and online application portal.
  • Ensure all mandatory documents—such as birth certificates, degree mark sheets, experience proofs, and category certificates—are ready for digital upload.
  • Submit the application form before the closing deadline on 22 November 2026.

*Note: Official notices, application links, and any subsequent corrigenda must be verified directly through the official NPCC website.*
